description.en: A fossil branch concept presents broad fan-shaped leaves with radiating divisions.
description.zh: 化石枝概念展示具有放射分裂的宽扇形叶。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Ginkgo yimaensis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Ginkgo yimaensis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Broad fan lamina with petiole differs from needle sprays, cycad pinnae and deeply dissected Baiera leaves.
distinctness.zh: 带叶柄宽扇叶面区别于针叶枝、苏铁羽片及深裂拜拉叶。

modeling_brief.en: Use faceted fan sheets attached to a compact short-shoot branch; keep reproductive details out unless matched to the specimen.
modeling_brief.zh: 用折面扇叶连接紧凑短枝，未与标本匹配前不添加生殖细节。

assets.uncertainty: A Jurassic specimen concept, not a claim that the living Ginkgo biloba phenotype was unchanged.

sources.title: Plants in the dinosaur world
sources.supports: Specimens of Czekanowskia, Phoenicopsis, Ginkgo and Baiera foliage.

description.en: An upright axis carries narrow forked leaves in a spiral arrangement.
description.zh: 直立轴螺旋着生细窄二叉叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Dicranophyllum; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Dicranophyllum 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Individual Y leaves along a main axis differ from Czekanowskia's bundled short-shoot leaf tufts.
distinctness.zh: 沿主轴单生Y叶区别于Czekanowskia短枝簇生叶束。

modeling_brief.en: Use a visible central leader and evenly readable forked blades; preserve attachment positions from one reconstruction.
modeling_brief.zh: 使用可见主轴和清晰叉叶，着生位置遵从一种重建。

assets.uncertainty: Reconstructed from incomplete compressions; affinity is not confidently equated with a living conifer family.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Reconstructing Dicranophyllum using morphological variability
sources.supports: Fork-leaved Dicranophyllum reconstruction based on many specimens.

description.en: A fossil compound frond has two rows of broad wedge-shaped leaflets.
description.zh: 化石复叶具两列宽楔状小叶。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Noeggerathia foliosa, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Noeggerathia foliosa 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Wedge leaflets in two rows differ from the four-rank unequal foliage of Paratingia and narrow cycad pinnae.
distinctness.zh: 两列楔叶区别于Paratingia四列不等小叶及苏铁窄羽片。

modeling_brief.en: Build a single planar rachis with overlapping wedge blades; inspect the original plate before locking leaflet tips.
modeling_brief.zh: 用单平面叶轴及重叠楔叶建形，确定叶尖前检查原图版。

assets.uncertainty: Frond concept only; whole habit and exact reproductive association are not asserted.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Palaeoecology of the late Palaeozoic Noeggerathiales
sources.supports: Noeggerathia fossil context and reconstruction discussion.

description.en: A large undivided strap-like leaf preserves a strong central rib.
description.zh: 大型不分裂带状叶保存强中央叶轴。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Bjuvia simplex, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Bjuvia simplex 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Its entire blade differs from the existing pinnate cycad, but may overlap Glossopteris. A central rib alone is not diagnostic enough; distinct visible blade-and-relief geometry must be demonstrated.
distinctness.zh: 全缘叶面不同于现有羽状苏铁叶，却可能与Glossopteris重叠；仅有中央叶轴不足以区分，须验证可见叶形与浮雕几何的差异。

modeling_brief.en: Follow the documented strap outline and central rib without inventing a rosette. Test it against Glossopteris at a comparable displayed size with neutral materials; retain both only if source-supported geometry reads distinctly.
modeling_brief.zh: 依据记录中的带状轮廓和中轴建形，不臆造莲座；以相近显示尺寸及中性材质对比Glossopteris，仅在有来源支持的几何差异清楚可见时保留两者。

assets.uncertainty: Historical whole-plant Cycas-like associations are not treated as proven. Separation from Glossopteris requires form review; larger size, a different pose or invisible vein characters are insufficient.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. Audit #129 comparison gate: Glossopteris and Bjuvia share an entire elongate blade. Production is blocked until a side-by-side neutral-material test at the intended viewing distance demonstrates source-supported geometric distinction. Scale, colour, texture-only veins, pose, damage and taxonomic labels cannot establish separate assets. If relief is unreadable or requires unsupported exaggeration, consolidate or replace one concept before production.

sources.supports: Bjuvia simplex large entire leaves and limits of whole-plant reconstruction.
